messages:
maria (AE): Hey team — prepping for a CISO call tomorrow about a POC. They specifically asked for our incident response timeline, vendor notification windows, and who their security contact is. Quick answers appreciated, especially any customer-facing template I can share. @jordan @sara @lee

jordan (Security Eng): High level: our usual internal target is acknowledge within 2h, initial investigation update within 24h, confirmed-impact customer notifications within 72h unless legal/regulatory requires faster. For high-severity (data exfiltration of customer data) we push to notify as soon as we have a verified scope.

jordan (Security Eng): Responsibilities: SRE leads triage + containment, Security owns customer/regulatory comms in partnership with Legal, CSM/AE handles customer outreach logistics.

sara (Legal): +1. Contract nuance: notification windows can be contractually shorter for some enterprise customers. For POC, default to our standard unless the customer has a specific clause. Also note cross-border data transfer rules may affect timelines.

lee (CSM): If we need to send customer-facing emails we usually coordinate with customer success to include: what happened, impacted data types, mitigation steps, recommended customer actions, contact for follow-up. I can own drafting if you want, maria.

maria (AE): That would be great, lee. Any canned template I can drop into the slide deck?

jordan (Security Eng): Putting a short template below you can share; keep it non-legal and flag that Legal will review before sending to production customers.

jordan (Security Eng): ```
Subject: Redwood Inference — Security Incident Update

Hi <CustomerName>,

We wanted to inform you of a security event affecting <service/region> that occurred on <date/time>. Our team has contained the issue and is actively investigating. At this time: 
- Scope: <what types of data/systems impacted, if known>
- Actions taken: <containment/mitigation steps>
- Recommended customer actions: <rotate keys, review logs, etc.>

We will provide another update within 24 hours and a full post-incident report within 30 days. For urgent questions contact: security@redwood.example (IR team) or your CSM.

Thank you for your patience,
The Redwood Security Team
```

sara (Legal): That template is fine as a starting point. Replace the 30 days with the SLA from the contract if it’s different. Also add a short line about regulatory reporting: "We will comply with applicable breach notification laws and regulators."

tom (SRE): For engineering details customers sometimes ask for timeline of detection -> containment -> remediation. Typical internal timeline we use for POC discussions: detection (t0), containment in <4h for infra issues, remediation lift depends but we provide an ETA in the 24h update.

devsecops-bot: Incident runbook v2.3 loaded — https://internal.redwood/runbooks/ir-v2.3 :bookmark: 

maria (AE): Perfect. Two follow-ups: 1) The prospect asked whether we notify upstream providers (cloud, marketplace) and partners. 2) They want to know if we have a designated SOC contact they can reach during POC hours.

jordan (Security Eng): 1) We notify upstream providers only if required (e.g., their system is involved or per contract). We avoid broad partner notif until scope confirmed. 2) We can provide an on-call contact for the POC: security-oncall@redwood.example (monitored 24/7) + a named engineer during business hours.

sara (Legal): Add that any joint notifications with partners require coordination and may need NDAs or disclosure approvals.

lee (CSM): I can share a short one-pager for the CISO: incident timeline bullets, contact points, and the canned template. Will tag legal for sign-off.

maria (AE): Thanks all — I'll drop the one-pager into tomorrow's slide and mark the template as "Legal review required". Any objections? :thumbsup:

jordan (Security Eng): :thumbsup: no objections.

sara (Legal): :thumbsup: please let Legal review final copy before sending to CISO.

maria (AE): Great — closing this thread. If the call surfaces any special contract clauses I'll reopen.

lee (CSM): Filing note in the deal workspace: POC security Qs answered, template + one-pager to be attached.

maria (AE): @devsecops-bot can you attach the runbook link to the deal in SFDC?

devsecops-bot: Done — runbook linked to SFDC opportunity OP-7831.
